title: New York Alumni Society founded
description: Penn's New York alumni organize the first local alumni group outside Philadelphia.

title: Club opens in the Royalton Hotel
description: Four ground floor rooms; about 200 feet west of today's Penn Club. 150+ members.

title: Club moves to the Hotel Stanley
Clubhouse opens on East 50th Street
description: Two townhouses next to the New York Palace Hotel; 20-year lease approved in 1922. Renovations about $20000. Nearly 1000 members by 1929.

title: Shares space at the Cornell Club
description: Remaining 350 members move after the Parsons estate sells the 50th Street property; about two months.

title: Club moves to Satterlee House
description: Stayed about three years before financial pressure forced another move.

title: Returns to 22 East 38th Street
description: Back in the newly vacant space shared earlier with Cornell; remained about one year.

title: Club moves to the Phi Gamma Delta Club
description: Moved in late 1939; remained until the building was sold in 1961.

title: Club takes space in the Biltmore Hotel
Alumni join Princeton Club as associate members
description: For about three decades Penn alumni wanting a university club became associate members of the Princeton Club.

title: University acquires the 65000 sq. ft. clubhouse
description: Hundreds of alumni and friends gather to celebrate the acquisition.

location_name: The Penn Club of New York
title: Penn Club officially opens
description: More than 7000 Charter Members joined by this date; opens on Clubhouse Row.
